gates_declared: before any net of this lane was trained; kind S of the terminal-symbols lane with neuronte-split-v9 on its own 113 symbols as the reference; identities over the whole tier
pass_rule: both seeds meet every rule at every counted size
selection_rule: of a passing group, the seed with the lower mean error over 8x16, 16x32 and 48x96
retry_rule: one, declared with the gates: a failing group trained once more at width 96, same characters, seeds and steps, judged by the same rules; still failing, it is left out
retry_note: A change to the declared recipe: the retry was not run for this bundle. The batch before it retried 23 failing groups at width 96 and none passed; the accented-letter bundle retried 72 and one passed; and the owner had decided that failed groups ship at width 64. Every group that failed at width 64 is recorded FAILED without a second attempt.
owner_choice: The owner decided on 2026-11-17, with the trained-net sheet of the first bundle open, that groups failing the declared gates ship at width 64 marked FAILED and owner-chosen, in all three bundles. The owner named no seed: of each such group the seed with the lower mean error over 8x16, 16x32 and 48x96 ships, the rule declared for the groups that pass.
evaluator: native library coverage, automatic sampling, each character through its own packed group net, against the training teacher supersampled 8x8; tests/check_reference.py on every packed net
